description: BEAM break handler intercepts SIGINT before it reaches :io.get_chars in the stdin reader. The KeyParser and handle_event code for Ctrl+C (0x03) are correct — the bytes just never arrive. Fix: add +Bc flag to the elixir invocation in the mix task or a wrapper script (elixir --erl '+Bc' -S mix pi). This suppresses the BEAM break handler and lets Ctrl+C flow through raw-mode stdin as byte 0x03. Verify: Ctrl+C in empty input triggers graceful exit; Ctrl+C during agent run cancels the run. Do NOT attempt :os.set_signal(:sigint, :handle) — :sigint is not in OTP's allowed signal set.
title: Ctrl+C exit via +Bc erl flag wrapper
